verdict.rationale: The only team-communication evidence is that Notion workspaces contain comments, which the API can read and create and which webhooks report as new-comment events. That suggests asynchronous discussion on pages where work is planned, but not real-time team chat. The 'chat' in the Agent APIs is chat with AI agents, not teammates, so it does not count. Missing for 10: a documented native team chat or messaging feature, real-time conversation threads, chat-tool integrations, and hands-on corroboration of in-tool team discussion.
